description: The ToN_IoT flow mirror used here has no timestamp column, so network flows cannot be joined to other sources on time
impact_on_marking: limits C5 correlation to IP and asset joins
workaround_or_plan: documented in the timeline as linkage_basis; obtain the original UNSW release with ts for Milestone 3

description: Namibia's ISO-2 country code 'NA' was read by pandas as a missing value, making every user-day look foreign
impact_on_marking: would have invalidated all access analytics
workaround_or_plan: fixed by switching to ISO-3 codes (NAM) plus a regression test (test_country_code_not_parsed_as_missing)

description: Isolation Forest fitted on all flows scores below chance (ROC-AUC 0.28) because attacks are the majority class in ToN_IoT
impact_on_marking: could look like a failed component
workaround_or_plan: kept and reported as a finding; a clean-baseline novelty variant (ROC-AUC 0.72) is provided alongside

description: The first adversarial baseline was computed on rows the model had trained on, inflating the reference F1
workaround_or_plan: the stage-08 split is now reproduced exactly and only test rows are perturbed

description: Access log, tickets, asset inventory and user directory are synthetic
impact_on_marking: must be declared in report, presentation and Q&A
workaround_or_plan: documented in README section 1, every provenance JSON and the executive brief

description: Ticket classification reaches macro-F1 1.000 because the corpus is template-generated
impact_on_marking: a marker may read it as overfitting
workaround_or_plan: caveat stored in nlp_summary.json and repeated in the notebook and README

description: UEBA rule R4 (out-of-hours privileged action) fires 99 times at 4 per cent precision
workaround_or_plan: kept deliberately as the contrast case for rule tuning; backlog item to make the threshold role-aware

description: Next-day early warning is weak (ROC-AUC 0.53) because alerts are rare and largely driven by single events
workaround_or_plan: reported as a negative result; would need a longer window or event-level features

description: Transmission probabilities are assumed; only p_foothold is measured from the data
workaround_or_plan: assumptions table plus sensitivity over +/-40 per cent; ranking is stable across all scales
